source.note: TS PCB (Techno-Service S.A., Gdańsk). One parameter page plus the PDF 'Parametry technologiczne obwodów TS PCB' updated 2026-05-29; quotes are Polish, verbatim, decimal commas kept. Track/gap tables are by base copper (Tab. 6 outer, Tab. 7 inner); the 18 µm base column is used for 1 oz finished outer copper. Product lines (TSka prototype, 5LT, series) have their own pages, not read. technoservice.pl refuses automated readers. Read 2026-11-11 by an automated page reader; `eda-agent fab-refresh` re-checks every quote against the live page.

copper_layer_counts.note: Minimum / maximum conductive layers; the PDF: 'wielowarstwowe do 12 warstw na laminacie FR4'. Listed as 1, 2 and even counts.

min_track.note: PDF Tab. 6, outer layers, by base copper 12/18/35/70/105/140/170/210 µm. 18 µm base (plated to 35 µm, 1 oz finished) gives 4 mil.

min_gap.note: PDF Tab. 6, outer, 18 µm base column.

min_laser_drill.unpublished: No laser drilling appears on the page or in the PDF.

min_annular_ring.note: PDF Tab. 8, outer layers, holes up to 5 mm; typical 5 mil. Inner rings need tear drops.
PDF Tab. 8, inner rings at 6 layers (8-12 layers: 'typ. 7 min. 5*'); * = tear drops required. The stricter inner figure governs the via.

pth_annular_ring.note: The tables do not separate component rings from via rings. Holes over 5 mm: 10 mil.

hole_to_copper_inner.note: PDF Tab. 8; how the three values map to layer counts is not clear from the extracted text, the smallest is stored.

min_mask_sliver.unpublished: No solder mask bridge figure on the page or in the PDF.

mask_expansion.unpublished: No solder mask expansion figure on the page or in the PDF.

min_silk_width.quote: Minimalna szerokość linii opisowej wynosi 4 mils (ok. 0,1 mm)
min_silk_width.note: White legend accepts 3 mil: 'Dla opisu białego dopuszcza się linie o szerokości 3 mils'.

min_silk_height.unpublished: No legend character height on the page or in the PDF.

silk_to_pad.unpublished: No figure; legend on solder pads is always removed: 'Elementy opisu wchodzące na pady lutownicze ... są zawsze usuwane'.

copper_to_edge.unpublished: No copper to routed edge clearance; only the routing tolerance.

copper_to_vcut.note: PDF Tab. 5, copper and mask to score line by laminate 0,55/0,80/1,00/1,20/1,55/2,00/2,40 mm; 0.4 mm is the 1.55 mm column.

max_aspect_ratio.unpublished: No aspect ratio; only a blind via depth formula.

pth_hole_tolerance.quote: standardowa tolerancja średnicy otworów metalizowanych: +0,1 mm / -0,05 mm

npth_hole_tolerance.quote: standardowa tolerancja średnicy otworów niemetalizowanych: +0,1 mm / -0,05 mm

max_board_size.unpublished: No maximum board size on the page or in the PDF.

via_in_pad.value: plugged and mask-covered, up to 0.6 mm, also in pads
via_in_pad.quote: Metoda pozwala zatykać otwory o maksymalnej średnicy 0,6 mm, w tym również otwory w padach

impedance_tolerance.unpublished: No impedance tolerance on the page or in the PDF.

ipc_class.quote: KLASA IPC klasa II klasa III
ipc_class.note: Both are offered; the page does not say which is the default.
